# CodexNotch 0.2.1
- **Settings window**: Clicking Settings again brings the existing window to the front. - **In-app updates**: Check for Updates can download, verify, install, and relaunch a new version without opening a download page.
If you are upgrading from 0.2.0 or earlier, install 0.2.1 manually once. Future updates can be installed from Settings, and your existing preferences are preserved.
DMG and ZIP downloads are available for Apple Silicon on macOS 14 or later. The app has not been notarized by Apple, so the DMG does not eliminate the first-launch security prompt. See the [installation guide](https://github.com/fengdwx/codex-notch/blob/v0.2.1/README.md#install).
